posts.raw_content:
I don’t necessarily agree with the decision, but it’s a reasonable decision and I trust Trump’s judgment. 

It is true that the “this will create more terrorists” argument is weak. You should also note that is NOT what Trump said. He actually said the opposite: live-streaming will have a deterrent effect on terrorists.

Trump understands our concerns but is also weighing the pros and cons. You need to trust the master at work. He has way better judgment than anyone on this website.

John Doyle went on a hilarious rant yesterday, saying that since the terrorist is in a wheel chair, we should get one of those giant mega-ramps they use in the X games and launch him into the Grand Canyon. I laughed so hard I almost shit myself.

But somewhere along the line, after listening to him salivate about different ways to kill the guy, i got tired of hearing it.

I was excited to see the execution, even though my brain had been mindfucked by violent images that I wish I’d never seen. This is like the guy getting eating by a tiger video. You think you want to see it, until you actually see it. It doesn’t matter how evil someone is. The site of seeing a human being killed is always disturbing on some level.

Now imagine what the video may do to a normie brain. We are talking about real trauma for millions of people. **The reason we stopped doing firing squads wasn’t because of mercy for the defendant, it was because of the trauma it causes for the people who shoot him and witnessed the shooting.** 

Even soldiers struggle to deal with this trauma. Normies cannot handle it. The Trump admin has an incentive to keep normies calm and happy, not to make them feel traumatized, like we’re back in WW2 and things are falling apart. Imagine a relatively normal MAGA girl, tuning into watch this video because everyone else is doing it. Then her brain is mindfucked by violence which she never should have witnessed in her entire life. All of a sudden, Jeb Bush appears holding out a compassionate hand, offering her a blue pill, letting her go back to blissful ignorance. 

This move will NOT help us win over normies. It will drive them towards feel-good cuckservatives and give MAGA the superficial appearance of “fascism” that they see in movies. 

I don’t necessarily agree with the decision to not livestream it, because I think the deterrent effect would be very strong, but it’s a reasonable decision that many good patriots agree with. It was not done out of “weakness,” but a calculated strategy, that weighs the pros AND CONS, to help our country win.

We are not living in the times of our ancestors. We are living in an abomination republic where retards and normies hold all the power via voting. We have to consider how this move will impact their opinion of MAGA. Truth is, many people say they want to watch this video, but after they watch a guy in a wheelchair being shot they will wish they hadn’t seen it. The subconscious part of our brain doesn’t care how evil the guy is, it just remembers “image of man in wheelchair being shot to death.”

The juice may not be worth the squeeze, is what Trump is arguing. Very reasonable opinion.
